note: Mom-and-pop RV park (est. 1982, ~83-90 sites) on the banks of the Cullasaja River near Franklin, with on-river and off-river sites; big-rig friendly; swim/fish/tube. --Claude
summary: Open and operating (no storm notice; 2025 & 2026 Visit Smokies award). Fees ($50 off river / $65 on river, effective Jan 1 2025, still posted) stand; $50 is at, not over, the gate. Confirmed 30/50-amp full hookups, year-round. Added hot showers, laundromat, Wi-Fi, camp store, phone/email reservations. Note trimmed of hookups and year-round.
flags: Long-stay leaning but passes: posts a daily rate ($50/$65 for two people) beside weekly, monthly ($800-900) and seasonal ($2,500-2,800) rates, and a resident-style activity calendar (bingo, Bible study, covered-dish dinners). Test 2 passes on the posted nightly rate; the share of sites sold nightly is not published.
